choices.text:
The bug is a buffer overflow: `add_slc` writes 3 bytes into `s->buf` (108 bytes) without ever checking whether `s->used + 3 <= SLCBUF_SIZE`. The caller invokes this once per received SLC option, and a TELNET LINEMODE negotiation can carry many SLC triplets, so `used` can exceed 108 and the writes at lines 18–20 go out of bounds. The check at line 14 only filters small `func` values; it does nothing to bound the buffer usage. The overflow first manifests at the write on line 18 (with lines 19–20 continuing the same 3-byte triplet write), so the smallest set of lines that introduce the bug is the triplet store.

Answer: 18,19,20
